datasets.title: India NCRB cybercrime cases by State/UT, 2021-2023
datasets.limitations: Public aggregate table from PIB release citing NCRB Crime in India. It cannot identify incidents, suspects, victims, or forensic artifacts.

datasets.title: India cyber-forensic capacity funding by State/UT
datasets.limitations: Funding/capacity proxy only. It does not measure lab throughput, backlog, tool quality, or conviction impact.

datasets.title: Global intentional homicide rates for selected countries
datasets.limitations: Cross-country aggregate rates support macro comparison only. They do not encode modus operandi, language, evidence, or offender linkage.

datasets.title: UK Police street-level crime sample, central London
datasets.limitations: Useful for schema comparison and geospatial UI testing. Do not treat a small coordinate sample as a city-wide crime baseline.

datasets.title: US BJS/FBI NIBRS violent incidents national estimates sample
datasets.limitations: NIBRS estimates are nationally representative public estimates, not raw case files. They are useful for schema and evaluation-design comparison.

notes: No personally identifiable operational police data is included.
Datasets are saved for research prototyping and paper-method discussion, not operational deployment.
